compatibility.target: reclean-v2 FP32 training/export contract (TorchMFCC triangular frontend)
compatibility.frontend: TorchMFCC float: pre_emphasis 0.97, 32 ms window/stride, 40 triangular mel bands [20, 8000] Hz, log, ortho DCT, 13 coefficients x 32 frames

training.lineage: reclean v2 CE line: i30(v410v2) init -> v419_a clean-start fix (3 epochs, lr 1e-5, AdamW, cosine)
training.dataset: kws_reclean_aug_v1 (offline augmented) + packed mixture: raw anchors, hard_negative_v419 pack, pos_fullspec_v7 low-SNR positives
training.excluded_from_training: cs/zh/yd real-recording speakers (anti per-person fitting); blind real recordings

measured_deployment.protocol: 1 s window, 96 ms hop, double-window confirmation, softmax positive score, no debounce

recapture_recall.yd_note: yd uses a first-tone 'hi' variant of the keyword; not waking is correct and is excluded from targets

measured_deployment.status: current delivery candidate of the reclean-v2 line; false-wake suppression to near-zero FAH still in progress (see handover notes in README)

provenance.conversion: model weights copied unchanged; optimizer, scheduler, history, and provenance stripped
